subject: Before and After School Care Program Expansion
overview: The School Committee approved a 60-seat expansion of the before and after school program, alongside tuition and wage increases to stabilize the department's staffing. The committee also extended the Superintendent’s contract for four years and updated several district policies regarding harassment and meeting procedures.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Bills
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the March 22 meeting and authorized various warrants and payrolls.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Curriculum Subcommittee, the Committee of the Whole, and the Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee.

items.title: Face Covering Policy
items.summary: Tabled the proposed policy until April 26 to allow for the inclusion of specific language regarding students with disabilities.

items.title: Procedural and Agenda Policies
items.summary: Approved several procedural changes, including the inclusion of student representatives in roll calls, the use of consent agendas for routine items, and moving minute approvals to the end of meetings.

items.title: Harassment and Staff Conduct Policies
items.summary: Approved new district policies regarding staff conduct (GBEB) and the prevention of harassment (ACAB) by students, employees, and third parties.

items.title: Superintendent Contract Extension
items.summary: Approved a four-year contract extension for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent.

items.title: COVID-19 Health and Testing Update
items.summary: Received a report on the city's yellow zone status and current testing data, with a warning regarding the UK variant and a reminder of travel quarantine protocols for April vacation.

items.title: K-12 Mathematics Curriculum Report
items.summary: Reviewed plans to resume piloting new elementary math programs and discussed high school pathways designed to prepare students for calculus.

items.title: Before and After School Programming
items.summary: Approved a tuition increase to $25 per day and staff wage hikes to support a 60-seat expansion of the program using school computer labs.

items.title: Public Participation on Childcare
items.summary: Community members advocated for more equitable access to afterschool programs, citing the financial burden of private care and the need for sliding scale tuition.

items.title: Student Vaccination Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling for a state-led vaccine rollout plan for school-aged children that empowers local officials to manage distribution.
